$comment: Light metadata for the DB schema explorer (apps/schema-explorer). The schema itself comes from live introspection; this file only adds groups, short notes and relations that have no foreign key. The operational grafana_product role has column-level SELECT grants only and adds no tables or implicit relations. Tables missing here appear under 'Unassigned'.

groups.name: Profile & topics
groups.description: Owner settings: the single profile, its daily schedule, topics and which sources feed each topic.

groups.name: Article ingestion
groups.description: RSS/HN sources and the deduplicated articles collected from them every 30 minutes.

groups.name: Editions
groups.description: Published digests. Each edition is an immutable JSON snapshot.

groups.name: AI usage & budget
groups.description: Anthropic (Haiku/Sonnet) call ledger, response cache, provider blocks and the daily reserve for the scheduled edition.

groups.name: X posts (free discovery)
groups.description: X posts found for free (linked from articles and news rivers), verified through X's official oEmbed.

groups.name: X search (paid, xAI)
groups.description: Capped xAI x_search calls and the posts each call surfaced.

groups.name: Reddit (parked)
groups.description: Built but switched off: Reddit blocks public access. Kept for a future official-API integration.

groups.name: Bluesky (preparation)
groups.description: Official API observation storage; collection and edition inclusion remain off.

tables.profiles: The single owner profile. Everything hangs off it.
tables.digest_schedules: When editions are generated (cron + timezone), the coverage window and default story/post budgets.
tables.topics: A digest section (Tech & AI, NBA, …): guidance, budgets, curated X accounts, a Bluesky search query and relevance rules.
tables.topic_source_connections: Many-to-many: which sources feed which topic. Only connected sources are collected.
tables.content_sources: An RSS/Atom feed or Hacker News, with its health (last success/error).
tables.content_items: One article, deduplicated by canonical URL across all sources.
tables.digest_previews: An edition: an immutable JSON snapshot of stories, briefs and posts per topic. A trigger blocks UPDATE/DELETE.
tables.llm_calls: Ledger of every Anthropic call: reservation, actual cost, tokens and status. Budgets are enforced from this table.
tables.llm_cache: Cached model responses keyed by a fingerprint of model + prompt, so regenerations only pay for new items.
tables.llm_provider_blocks: Records that the provider refused calls this month (e.g. the workspace spend limit).
tables.scheduled_ai_budget_days: Per UTC day: the AI budget held back for the scheduled edition and how that run ended.
tables.social_posts: A social post: verified X embeds, parked Reddit cards, or Bluesky API observations (collection off).
tables.x_link_citations: An article that links to an X post. The main free discovery signal.
tables.article_x_discovery_checks: Which article pages have been scanned for X links (and when).
tables.social_discovery_sources: News 'rivers' (Techmeme, Memeorandum) scanned for X links.
tables.social_discovery_citations: X posts seen on a river page.
tables.x_embed_checks: Results of checking a post through X's official oEmbed (verification).
tables.x_discovery_calls: Ledger of paid xAI searches: reservations, costs, topic/day/style admission and actual provider-reported tool inputs.
tables.x_search_citations: X posts returned by a paid search, with engagement as reported by xAI.
tables.x_discovery_provider_block: Set when xAI refuses calls (e.g. credits depleted); stops further paid searches.
tables.reddit_x_citations: Reddit posts that link to X posts (parked; empty).
tables.schema_migrations: Which SQL files in migrations/ have been applied.
tables.bluesky_observations: Immutable per-topic Bluesky snapshots with observation time, engagement, text and media.
tables.x_search_topic_settings: Per-topic X search reaction/trending like thresholds and exclusion operators.
tables.edition_job_failures: Failed on-demand edition job IDs and duration, retained after Redis history pruning; no exception text.
tables.edition_job_requests: Accepted on-demand job IDs retained to explain jobs missing from Redis without regenerating.
tables.development_spend_pools: Nonrenewing development allowances per provider; hard code and database ceilings.
tables.development_spend_reservations: Development holds and confirmed charges, isolated from production ledgers and scheduled reserves.

relations.note: X post id (platform 'x'). No FK: citations are stored before the post is verified.
X post id seen on a river page.

Scheduled runs share one id: '<profile id>:<slot ms>'.
